summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, reported via Form 6-K that on September 8, 2026 it entered an at-the-market sales agreement with Chaince Securities, LLC as sales agent for up to US$200,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.009, under its effective Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-296301) and a September 10, 2026 Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement. Agent compensation is a 3.0% cash fee plus a 1.0% non-accountable expense allowance; either party may terminate on five days notice. No shares are committed; net proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation.
